mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SUPPORT ( support_reason_id, user_id, title, content, status, created_at ) VALUES ( COALESCE( #{reason}, (SELECT MIN(sr.support_reason_id) FROM SUPPORT_REASON sr WHERE sr.is_active = 1) ), #{userId}, CONCAT( IFNULL(#{type}, 'REPORT'), ' / ', IFNULL(#{targetType}, ''), ' / ', IFNULL(#{targetId}, '') ), #{content}, 'PENDING', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUPPORT_REASON WHERE support_reason_id = #{reason} AND is_active = 1
SELECT support_reason_id AS reasonId, reason_name AS reasonName FROM SUPPORT_REASON WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY support_reason_id
